description: Seed review and approval routes. PRD F-009 requires routes configurable by document type, process, risk and authority without editing flow logic. Assignees are placeholders until OQ-13 is answered.
status: Provisional - assignee groups require confirmation (OQ-13). Resolution algorithm is not provisional.

resolution.algorithm: Match all active rules whose criteria match the submitted document. Each criterion is either an exact value or the wildcard '*'. Specificity = count of non-wildcard criteria. The highest-specificity matching rule set wins. A tie between two rule sets at equal specificity is a configuration error and raises a MissingRoute blocking exception rather than picking arbitrarily.
resolution.noMatchBehaviour: Raise a blocking MissingRoute exception, do not submit, and return an actionable message to the author. PRD F-009, F-022.
resolution.ambiguousMatchBehaviour: Raise a blocking MissingRoute exception naming the competing rules. Never choose arbitrarily.
resolution.separationOfDuties: A resolved assignee who is the sole author of the revision is removed from the stage and, if the stage would then be empty, a blocking exception is raised. PRD SEC-003.

ruleSets.name: Confidential override - adds security review
ruleSets.note: Specificity 1. Demonstrates a risk-based override. Because SOP-default is also specificity 1, a Highly Confidential SOP produces an ambiguous match and a blocking exception until Document Control adds an explicit combined rule. This is deliberate: the system refuses to guess an approval route.
